governing_principle: This registry is the single source of record for the fourteen governing conditions of the search-to-action journey. The Score instrument's statements, the framework page's condition prose, and the audit report template all derive from these entries. A condition change starts here, is logged in DECISION_LOG.md, and propagates outward — never the reverse.

conditions.statement: The primary pages receiving search traffic were designed around a defined search intent, documented before the page was written.
conditions.audit_evidence_guidance: Documented intent definitions (briefs, content contracts) predating page publication; mapping of top entry pages to their declared intents.

conditions.statement: On each major entry page, the first screen addresses the question the visitor searched before introducing anything else.
conditions.audit_evidence_guidance: Above-the-fold review of each major entry page against its driving queries; does the first screen answer the searched question before anything else.

conditions.statement: Every indexable page has a unique title, a controlled meta description, exactly one H1, and a canonical URL.
conditions.audit_evidence_guidance: Crawl of all indexable pages: titles, meta descriptions, H1 count, canonical tags — uniqueness and control verified page by page.

conditions.statement: The asset's key pages are indexed and appear for the queries they were designed to serve.
conditions.audit_evidence_guidance: Index coverage from Search Console or equivalent; query-to-page appearance for the queries each page was designed to serve.

conditions.statement: Key pages load quickly and are fully usable on mobile devices without layout breakage.
conditions.audit_evidence_guidance: Load performance and mobile usability measurement on key pages; layout stability under viewport constraints.

conditions.statement: Core content remains readable and navigable when JavaScript fails or loads slowly.
conditions.audit_evidence_guidance: JavaScript-disabled rendering of core content routes; content readability and navigation without script execution.

conditions.statement: Claims on commercial pages are supported by evidence; no guarantees or performance promises the asset cannot substantiate.
conditions.audit_evidence_guidance: Claim inventory of commercial pages; each claim traced to supporting evidence; guarantees and unsupported promises flagged.

conditions.statement: Identity, terminology, and visual presentation are consistent across every page of the asset.
conditions.audit_evidence_guidance: Cross-page consistency review: naming, terminology, visual presentation, tone — divergence catalogued.

conditions.statement: From any entry page, the intended next step is visible and evident without hunting or guesswork.
conditions.audit_evidence_guidance: Entry-page walkthroughs: is the intended next step visible without hunting; decision-point clarity assessment.

conditions.statement: No page is a dead end: every page links onward to a purposeful next destination.
conditions.audit_evidence_guidance: Full-route link audit: pages without purposeful onward destinations identified.

conditions.statement: Each key page has one clearly defined terminal action, and it completes without friction on all devices.
conditions.audit_evidence_guidance: Terminal action execution on all key pages across devices; friction points in the completion path documented.

conditions.statement: Nothing interrupts the path to action: no popups, forced steps, or competing calls to action.
conditions.audit_evidence_guidance: Interruption inventory: popups, forced steps, competing calls to action on the path to the terminal action.

conditions.statement: The actions the asset drives are the ones the operation actually needs, and they are measured.
conditions.audit_evidence_guidance: Mapping of driven actions to stated operational needs; measurement coverage of each terminal action.

conditions.statement: Those measurements are reviewed on a defined cadence, and findings feed back into the asset.
conditions.audit_evidence_guidance: Review cadence evidence: who reviews the measurements, on what schedule, and what changes resulted.
